title: Decode: DSA exact top-k + DCP merge
shape: D3-32 r24: 96 requests / DP rank (384 verify rows), L≈135K (local ≈33.75K on DCP4), k=3; also r1 (16 rows), r8 (128 rows)
basis: MEASURED microbench (4 GPUs = one DCP4 group, Rhea VR200, decode wiring launch, CUDA-graph us/call, relu-like logits, L=135K): v2 27.1/26.9/34.2 us per layer at r1/r8/r24 (in-tree 30.4/45.3/85.7); current_ms = r24 x 24 DSA layers. achievable = rhea1n model_rows B96: DSA.topk 1.9 + P8 7.5 us/layer (r8 0.64 + 6.4, r1 0.08 + 5.9)
gap_analysis: v2 (3d340bcf5e) removed the pre-pass kernels, the max_model_len-bound launch shape and the tie round (the band of global ids resolves ties straddling ranks in round 1 on 100% of bench rows). Remaining per-row chain (clock64 phase stamps, r1 / r24 us): sample 1.4/2.2, theta 0.6/0.7, candidate pass 8.5-9.5/10.4, fine window + band + msg 3.5/3.9, NVLink round 2.8-6/3-6 (includes rank skew), resolve 5/6.5, WRITE 3.5/4.5. A standalone probe of the same candidate loop runs 2.9 us (r1) / 3.3 us (r24) and a CTA pulls a 67.5 KB row into registers in 0.8-1.0 us, so the in-kernel loop runs ~3x slower than the probe (no spills: 62 regs, 0 local; cause under investigation); the other phases are chains of small dependent steps (syncs, single-thread loops). Model gap: the model prices one L2 pass + one NVLink round (~9.4 us at r24); the floor from hwdb measurements is ~1 us load + ~3 us round + local merge.
inefficiencies: FIXED: tie round through the leader state machine with an extra key pass (ebc6916ed5)
FIXED: launch shape bounded by max_model_len -> pre-pass kernels 41-46 us at r24 (v2 has none)
FIXED: second NVLink round for ties straddling ranks (band of global ids rides on round 1)
MEASURED: v2 candidate pass 8.5-10 us vs 3 us for the same loop standalone (cause open)
MEASURED: resolve (5-6.5 us) and WRITE (3.5-4.5 us) are chains of small synced steps; single-thread loops remain (band pick, class)
MEASURED: one CTA per row leaves 196 of 212 SMs idle at r1 and 84 idle at r8: rows should split over a cluster for the key pass at small batch
merge kernel PDL: v2 launches with programmatic serialization (prologue overlap) but never releases dependents early (trtllm-gen consumer reads counts before its wait)
rubin_features: NVLink multicast (multimem.st) for the candidate/histogram exchange
thread-block clusters + DSMEM for per-row parallel histogram reduce
PDL (griddepcontrol) chaining with the indexer logits kernel and the sparse core
TMA bulk loads of logits tiles
plan: DONE 1-4: measure; in-place tie round; topk_v2 exact (ALL PASS); decode wiring on v2
5. close the candidate-pass gap (in-kernel 3x slower than probe), then cut per-key instructions (NaN-propagating max as the bound, tighter theta)
6. collapse resolve/WRITE into fewer synced steps; remove single-thread loops
7. cluster split of the key pass for r1/r8 (DSMEM candidate merge into the leader)
8. distributed integration test (tests/distributed/test_kimi_k3_sdec_sp_layers.py exchange) + INFRA step_d A/B at rows 128/384, then landed-ready
